rows.en: Can't you break that boulder somehow?
Could you break that boulder somehow?
Is there any way you could break that boulder?
Couldn't you just break that boulder?
Why don't we just smash that boulder?
If we destroy that boulder, we're there.
If we can destroy that boulder, we'll be there in no time.
Is there any way you could break that boulder?
...All right, I'll give it a try.
Kamen Rider 2 tried all sorts of ways to destroy the boulder...
But the boulder was unnaturally tough, and no matter what he did, he couldn't destroy it.
Hmph, looks like it's no use!
Can't be helped. Let's look for another way.
Hey, Rider 2. How did you know?
Color me surprised. Who'd have thought the enemy built a secret passage in a place like this!!
"In a place like this"... huh. Whatever. Let's go!
A rock...? Any way you look at it, this isn't... an ordinary rock.
Hah... hah... Damn those heroes... This time for sure...
Ahh... Neo-Organism... O mysterious power... Grant me a power that surpasses the gods!!
Neo-Organism... Grant me... a power that surpasses the gods!!
Fufufufu... Bee Woman, you want to become stronger? Very well, I shall grant that wish!
Yaaay, thank youuu... Time to eeeat~
In the blink of an eye, the Neo-Organism absorbed Bee Woman!
Bee Woman's grudge and the Neo-Organism's power have fused... It's being born!!
The mightiest, most terrible kaijin in all of Shocker's history...!!
Well done, Neo-Organism. This kaijin's name is Doras!!
Now then, let us put its power to the test at once...
I know you're there, heroes! This Armored Samurai Kaijin shall finish you off!!
At that moment, screams came from the next room.
Ohh...!! Looks like Rider 1 and 2's modification surgery began before we could finish you!
Huh? Rider 2? Then who the hell is this!!
Hahahahaha... You fell for it hook, line and sinker!!
Every move you made was leaked straight to us through Gaina Ninpo, you know?
Fufufufufu... That's right, I am the Kaima Beastman, Gaina Ninpo!!
I used my Face-Copying Technique to disguise myself as Rider 2!! Ukii!! Ukikiiii!!
A Crisis Kaima Beastman!! You tricked us!? I won't forgive you!!
Now, Gaina Ninpo! And Doras!! Drown these wretches in their own blood!!
There, there... Come along with me.

notes.note: #0.56-0.65: party-leader variants asking (the fake) Rider 2 to break the boulder; Rider 2 answers #0.66. Voiced from wording. #0.59/#0.65 identical JP -> identical EN. #0.62-0.64 use 'we' (speaker proposes destroying it; actor not fixed).
Refers to Rider 2's earlier 'the cross is close by': destroying the boulder gets them there at once.
'he' = Rider 2 (actually Gaina Ninpo in disguise, also male).
Yes/No prompt for the key item 'Spiner' (Science Patrol super-explosive from Ultraman). Not in glossary; spelled Spiner.
No speaker recovered; the 0329 script trace skips this row. Assumed Ankh (he speaks #0.4 and #0.7 and is suspicious of Rider 2).
Rider 2 (impostor), speaker from script trace; jovial 'teki-san' rendered with a light tone.
Ankh (script trace) echoing Rider 2's words with suspicion; foreshadows the impostor reveal.
#0.9-0.17: party-leader variants reacting to the rock (script trace: TextIdOffset+8+pt_01_txt). #0.15 is the rough variant.

#0.1-0.16 (Doras branch) have no speakers in the script trace (trace follows the Armored Samurai Kaijin branch). Inferred: #0.1-0.3 and #0.8-0.9 Bee Woman; #0.4-0.5, #0.12-0.13, #0.15-0.16 Ikadevil (commands the Neo-Organism, as in #0.40/#0.45); #0.6-0.7, #0.11 Neo-Organism (childish 'boku'); #0.14 Doras.
'Neo-Organism' (Kamen Rider ZO's Neo Lifeform) and 'Doras' are not in the glossary; used the Kamen Rider Wiki English names. No pronoun used for the Neo-Organism.
Trailing line break in JP dropped. Box limit: 'obsession' tightened to 'grudge' and the doubled 'it is being born, this is being born' collapsed to one 'It's being born!!'.
Ikadevil names the 'Armored Samurai Kaijin' even though this row sits next to the Doras branch; the line seems shared with the Armored Samurai branch (0331 #0.146+). Translated as written.
#0.21-0.22 '???' = the captured Rider 1 and Rider 2 screaming in the next room (Ikadevil confirms in #0.23).
Speaker label is Rider 2 because the impostor still wears his face; content is Gaina Ninpo revealing himself. 'Kaima Beastman' for kaima-juujin (RX term).
'Face-Copying Technique' for the ninjutsu name (kao-utsushi no jutsu); not in glossary.
#0.30-0.39: party-leader variants. 'We' restored in #0.32-0.35 (the whole team was fooled).
No speaker recovered; Ikadevil (archaic 'koyatsura'). Doras branch.
#0.42 and #0.44 Neo-Organism; #0.43 and #0.45 Ikadevil (inferred, no speakers recovered).

report: 80/80. Speakers inferred for 0329 #0.5 (Ankh) and the Doras scene 0331 #0.1-0.16, #0.40-0.45 (Bee Woman / Ikadevil / Neo-Organism / Doras). 0331 #0.17 names the Armored Samurai Kaijin next to the Doras branch; kept as written. Not in glossary: Spiner, Neo-Organism, Doras, Face-Copying Technique, Kaima Beastman.
